ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear matrix tape of a legendary ’73 show with a monster Dark Star→Eyes of the World→China Doll stretch and killer performances throughout.
ai_review.review: The recording captures the concert in exceptional matrix quality – a seamless blend of board and audience that many reviewers call “among the finest” and “crisp”. The performance is hailed as one of the band’s best of ’73, highlighted by a 47‑minute Dark Star → Eyes of the World → China Doll journey, a gritty Loose Lucy opener, and Donna Jean’s standout take on “You Ain’t Woman Enough”. Energy is off the charts, with a juicy Phil bass solo and high‑octane jams that keep listeners “oozing with life”.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly positive reviews praise both the show (energy, standout Dark Star sequence) and the matrix recording’s clarity; only a single low‑star comment concerns track cueing, not performance quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the sound as crisp, lifelike, and among the best matrix recordings; one note mentions a brief blip/hesitation at track transitions that some listeners dislike.

standout_songs: You Ain't Woman Enough (Donna Jean vocal)
Phil's bass solo (between Dark Star and Eyes)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong first set builds into a soaring second set; the centerpiece is a 47‑minute Dark Star → Eyes of the World → China Doll suite that showcases deep improvisational flow.

band_member_comments.Phil: Praised for a juicy bass solo between Dark Star and Eyes of the World; noted as a highlight of the night.
